expect_head.description: ADDITIVE (DES-CHAT-ARTIFACTS-001 §6.2): the head the run worked from. The draft lands only on that head; otherwise nothing lands and draft.conflict is emitted. Absent or null: lands on the current head, as before.

run_id.description: ADDITIVE (DES-CHAT-ARTIFACTS-001 §6.2): the run that made the draft, recorded on the version it lands and on version.created. Absent or null: no run.
